A small update with fixes for undo and previews, plus a few new preferences.

- Fixed text previews showing only the first letter. Closes #137.
- Fixed Ctrl+Z sometimes needing several presses. Closes #138.
- Added middle-click tab closing, enabled by default. You can turn it off in Preferences. Closes #139.
- Fixed Magic Wand previews when adjusting tolerance and anti-aliasing. Closes #140.
- Improved background-removal memory cleanup and added AI memory settings. Closes #141.
- Windows EXE and Linux builds now use portable storage by default. You can switch to profile storage in Preferences after restarting. Closes #142.
